data.reasoning: The package is a standard AUR wrapper for an EndeavourOS ISO. The PKGBUILD uses PGP signature verification for the ISO and standard checksums for the payload. The only disagreement stems from an API error in the Qwen model when processing a license file, which Deepseek successfully reviewed and found safe. There is no malicious code or injection.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely due to a tool error (HTTP 400 API failure) in the Qwen model when attempting to audit the DISTRIBUTION-LICENSE file, resulting in an inconclusive verdict for that file and the overall package. Deepseek successfully audited the same file and correctly identified it as a safe license text.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review DISTRIBUTION-LICENSE due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors to prevent a single file failure from rendering the entire package audit inconclusive.
Consider using a lighter model or simple heuristic checks for obvious non-executable files like LICENSE and DISTRIBUTION-LICENSE to reduce API costs and failure rates.
